titre: Paiements sans contact par carte dans la zone euro
sous_titre: Milliards de paiements par semestre, 2024 à 2025

2e sem. 2024.texte: Number of contactless card payments in second half of 2024 increased by 15.5% to 29.5 billion

1er sem. 2025.texte: The number of contactless card payments initiated at a physical electronic funds transfer point of sale terminal was 29.6 billion

2e sem. 2025.texte: Number of contactless card payments in second half of 2025 was 32.9 billion, 11.9% higher compared with second half of 2024
